claim_reviews.conclusion: Correct and idiomatic Indonesian for “registration fee.”

claim_reviews.conclusion: “Different-common-word” is justified as a useful variety preference, not an absolute exclusivity claim. “Bayaran pendaftaran” overlaps across varieties, but this does not make either answer wrong. No false-friend contrast applies.

response.rationale: Both answers accurately express “registration fee.” “Biaya pendaftaran” is the ordinary Indonesian form, while Malaysian reference terminology supports “yuran pendaftaran.” “Bayaran pendaftaran” is also a valid broader alternative, so the contrast is preferential rather than exclusive. No false-friend issue is present.
